Ships as a DeepSeek Harness plugin and an MCP server."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 蒸留蔵 — distill-kura"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A long-term memory for agents that is distilled, not accumulated.**
Recall works by *meaning*, wri"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ting is gated by *evidence*, and one server can hold
several separate memories — one per agent mode "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"— so switching mode switches what the
agent remembers."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Ships as a DeepSeek Harness plugin,
an MCP server for any other host, an HTTP service, and a Python "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"library. Standard
library only; no vector database, no embeddings, no framework."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Two failures kill an agent's long-term memory, and they kill it from opposite sides."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Retrieval by keyword misses the thing you needed.** A question about *"SSD inference
chips"* share"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"s no word with a memory titled *"running the 2.6T model off an SSD tier"* —
yet they are the same su"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"bject. Word search returns nothing; the agent answers from
nowhere. The fix here is not embeddings b"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"ut *recognition*: the entire index (one line
per memory, written as a recognition trigger) goes into"},{"id":"p8s5","text":" one prompt, and a small model
names what bears on the question. An index of ~500 memories is around"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" 6k tokens — a
few percent of a modern context window, and it sits in the prefix cache."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"**Writing everything poisons the store.** An agent asserts something; a naive distiller
records the "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"assertion as a fact; the next agent reads it back as ground truth and
repeats it with more confidenc"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e. That loop is self-reinforcing, and prompt instructions
do not stop it — measured, not assumed. So"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" the write path is gated by deterministic
Python: every candidate memory must carry quotes that exis"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"t *character-for-character*
in the raw material, tagged with where they came from."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| class | what it is | what it licenses |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| `[USER]` | the human's own words | "they decided", "they asked" |
| `[TOOL]` | machine output | **"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"numbers — the only source** |
| `[ACT]` | a tool that was invoked | "this was done" |
| `[SELF]` | t"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"he agent's own prose | a judgement, in the first person, never a bare fact |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"A quote that is not found verbatim is discarded. A candidate with no surviving quote is
thrown away."},{"id":"p12s2","text":" A number with no `[TOOL]` behind it is stripped. Text crediting the human
with a decision, when no "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"`[USER]` quote survived, is refused at the last gate. Ideas are
welcome — they go to a seed file, ne"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ver to the store, and graduate only when later
evidence confirms them."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Tier zero: recognition before intelligence"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The recall above is the right tool for a question that shares no words with its
memory. It is the wr"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ong tool for a question that *names* what it wants — and in a
working session, most questions do. A "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"blind 40-question benchmark on a live
317-memory store split exactly along that line: the direct que"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"stions needed no
intelligence at all, and everything else needed all of it."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"So before the thinker runs, a deterministic recognizer gets one look. The design is
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Where it goes, and why that is a cache decision"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"A prefix cache is lost from the first changed byte onward — measured on one local
server: an identic"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"al 4,029-token preamble reprices from 0.68 s to 0.14 s, appending at
the **end** stays 0.14 s, and *"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"*one word added at the front costs the whole cache
(0.66 s)**. The persona commonly carries a clock,"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" so it changes every minute; the map is
the largest block in the prompt and changes a few times a da"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"y. The big stable thing goes
in front of the thing that ticks."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The block itself therefore contains no date, no clock, no counter — and `build()`
refuses a header t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"hat does, at build time rather than through mysteriously slow turns
three weeks later."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## What a memory looks like"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"One file, one fact."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"And one line in `MEMORY.md`:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"That line is the only thing read *every single time*. It is a **recognition trigger**,
not a summary"},{"id":"p25s2","text":": proper nouns, numbers, ⚠️ landmines, the conclusion reached. If a line
could be swapped with anoth"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"er memory's line and still read fine, it is not doing its
job — `kura distill tidy` finds the mechan"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ically detectable cases and rewrites them."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The four lines under `metadata`/at the top are **curation, not facts**: `tags` are
words about the m"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"emory's character — several is normal, and a memory written before
they existed simply has none — an"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"d the three sentences say why it belongs in *this*
store, what meaning must outlive any later thinni"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ng, and what detail need not. The
distiller proposes them against the store's charter; tags that cla"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"im something about
the human (`entrusted`, `emotion-carried`, `recurred`) are checked against the qu"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"otes
and the check is recorded in the manifest. `recurred` is written once, by the
distiller, when t"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"he human brings a topic up again from another session — it is a
property, not a counter, and there i"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"s no number behind it."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`kura doctor` reports counts, dead links, islands (memories nothing links to), index
drift, tag line"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"s it cannot read, manifests a memory points at that are gone, the state
of the learned profile, and "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"the store's **capacity in four units side by side** —
memories, index tokens, body tokens, bytes — w"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ith `limit` and `pressure` left `None`.
It is the eye the metabolism needs. What happens when a shel"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"f is full is not decided
yet: see `docs/DESIGN.md` §8."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## What this runs against"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| | requirement |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Python | 3.11+ (no dependencies; `pip install -e ".[dev]"` only adds pytest) |
| Node | 20+, for t"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"he DSH plugin only |
| `zstd` | only to read DSH session archives |
| model endpoint | anything answ"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ering `POST <url>/chat/completions` in the OpenAI shape |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**"OpenAI-compatible" is narrower than "any provider."** A vendor's native API needs an
OpenAI-compa"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"tible gateway in front of it; its own URL will not do. A strict service also
rejects unknown top-lev"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"el fields, so set `dialect = "openai"` (or `"generic"`) — the
default `"vllm"` sends `chat_template_"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"kwargs`, which local servers want and a strict one
400s on. The client retries once with a plain bod"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"y and records *why* a call failed
rather than collapsing every cause into a silent `None`."}],"truncated":true}
